facts.fact: The Bank of Tanzania issued its 2025 cloud guidelines, signed by Governor Emmanuel Mpawe Tutuba, which bar mission-critical systems of financial service providers (core banking, payments infrastructure, essential databases) from being hosted outside Tanzania.
facts.system: Bank of Tanzania Cloud Computing Guidelines for Financial Service Providers, 2025

facts.fact: Under the guidelines the Bank of Tanzania itself approves cloud arrangements in writing for financial service providers it licenses, and sets sanctions for breach up to licence revocation.
